captions.detailed: An independent rear trailing-arm suspension assembly. It features a central transverse cross-member beam with mounting brackets on each end. Two trailing arms are connected to these brackets via horizontal revolute joints, and each arm carries a wheel hub assembly with a tire. The wheels can rotate freely on continuous joints, and the arms can pivot vertically to simulate suspension travel.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated independent rear trailing-arm suspension assembly. Include a flat transverse cross-member with mounting brackets, two trailing arms attached via horizontal revolute joints, and two wheels with tires on continuous rotational joints at the ends of the trailing arms.
captions.factory: Create a base cross-member using a box primitive, adding mounting brackets at each end. Define two trailing-arm parts using combined box geometries. Model the wheels with nested cylinders for the hub, rim, and tire. Define revolute joints between the cross-member brackets and the trailing arms, and continuous joints between the trailing arms and the wheels.
